limitations: Original legacy Go intentionally performs different internal work; only native-go/node have matched declared semantic boundaries.
Memory is lifetime peak working set including imports and warmups, not per-job live heap. Node source imports remain broader than the Go replay module.
No database, HTTP, policy, provider or UI execution is timed. Six samples do not establish p95 or capacity.
